title: Runner batch wrappers must not report PASS with no completed steps, and holds must not stop a wrapper by signal
outcome: A hand-written remote batch script reports PASS only when every step ran and passed, and a boundary hold stops a batch between steps without killing the running launcher.
acceptance: The runner dispatch template and its batch script shape report a non-pass whenever fewer steps completed than were listed, and a boundary hold is taken through a flag the script checks between steps, never by signalling a process.
